scripts.build: npm --prefix seKUrity_backend run build && npm --prefix seKUrity_bot run build && npm --prefix seKUrity_web run build
scripts.check: npm --prefix seKUrity_backend run check && npm --prefix seKUrity_bot run check && npm --prefix seKUrity_web run check
scripts.nginx:reload: docker compose exec -T nginx nginx -t && docker compose exec -T nginx nginx -s reload
scripts.weekly-test:up: docker compose --env-file .env --env-file .env.weekly-test -p sekurity-weekly-test -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.weekly-test.yml up -d --build
scripts.weekly-test:down: docker compose --env-file .env --env-file .env.weekly-test -p sekurity-weekly-test -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.weekly-test.yml down -v
scripts.db:reset:scrums: docker compose exec -T backend node dist/scripts/reset-scrum-data.js
scripts.db:reset:weekly-misses: docker compose exec -T backend node dist/scripts/reset-weekly-misses.js
